question: I'm following along with this watch battery replacement. Please guide me through each step as it happens.

ground_truth.response: Start by using a precision screwdriver to unscrew and remove the resin strap protectors from both sides of the watch case.
ground_truth.event_description: Removing strap protectors

ground_truth.response: Flip the watch over and unscrew the four Phillips-head screws on the stainless steel back plate. Keep the screws safe as you remove them.
ground_truth.event_description: Unscrewing the back plate

ground_truth.response: Remove the back plate, then use tweezers to lift out the black rubber gasket to expose the internal movement.
ground_truth.event_description: Removing the plate and gasket

ground_truth.response: Use your tweezers to release the metal tension clip. Remove the old battery and insert a new silver coin cell battery, then snap the clip shut.
ground_truth.event_description: Replacing the battery

ground_truth.response: Carefully place the rubber gasket back over the internal components, then align the stainless steel back plate on top.
ground_truth.event_description: Replacing gasket and plate

ground_truth.response: Reinsert the four small screws into the back plate and tighten them firmly with your screwdriver.
ground_truth.event_description: Screwing the back plate

ground_truth.response: Finally, slide the resin strap protectors back onto the sides of the case and secure them with their original screws.
ground_truth.event_description: Reattaching strap protectors
